authority: None. The audit ledger under docs/audit/data/ledger/ remains the sole ruling surface for landed claims. Where this index and the ledger disagree about a landed note, the ledger is right.

coverage_gaps.detail: Of the 3,074 branch-only notes, 1,217 carry a named branch list from the off-main sweep. The remaining 1,857 carry only the commit sha that first added them; the branches that hold that commit were not re-derived, because that requires re-running the full-ref walk.

The survey headline of 2,510 branch-only science notes is a name-filtered subset. The unfiltered count of docs/*.md that never reached a mainline and never held a row is 3,074. All 3,074 are listed here; science_name_filter records which side of the filter each fell on. 373 of the 564 filtered-out paths are treated as notes by the off-main sweep, so the filter is not a clean note/non-note split.

The March stratum is cut at the month boundary. The same .claude/science/** directory family accumulates 7,358 unique paths across the whole project history, and 84 further logs/*.txt run logs first appear in April 2026. Those are per-loop working scratch rather than era-defining science notes, and are not enumerated here.
Open-PR and closed-PR items carry no created date, because the survey recorded them from pull request objects rather than from commit history.

5 of the 3,074 branch-only paths appear in the ever-rowed path union, meaning a row once existed for a path of that name. They are retained in this stratum; the overlap was not individually adjudicated.

method: Point-in-time enumeration built from a full-ref git walk of the repository (2,914 refs at the time of the walk) cross-checked against the audit ledger shards under docs/audit/data/ledger/. Item lists are taken from the survey extracts and re-verified against the ledger path list, the tip document list and the per-ref add history; where the survey narrative and the data disagreed, the data was kept and the difference recorded under coverage_gaps. This index enumerates science that has no ledger row; it carries no claim authority and makes no statement about whether any listed item is correct.

strata.description: Science written before the docs/ note format existed, in the event-network-model era that opens at the true repository root (7a5f1dca05, 2026-03-13). Claim notes live under .claude/science/**; run logs under logs/*.txt. Pushed directly, without pull requests. The registrar walks docs/** only, so none of this was ever eligible for a ledger row.

April 2026 notes that were on the mainline but were deleted before the 2026-04-26 seeding run first built the ledger, so no row was ever minted for them. origin/main's history has since been rewritten, so these are reachable only through archive refs that still descend from the true root.

docs/*.md notes that were committed on a branch or tag and never reached any mainline, and never held a ledger row. Counted here unfiltered; the science_name_filter flag marks the subset that passes the survey's science-note naming filter.
Notes on open pull requests whose head branch lives on origin. These are correctly pending, not missing: a row is minted when the pull request lands.
Notes that exist only inside fork-hosted pull request objects, with no branch on origin carrying them. Rescued byte-for-byte into archive_unlanded/fork_pr_rescue_2026_08_05/ by this census.
Notes on pull requests that were closed without merging and never landed by any other route. The in_origin_main_history flag marks the ones still recoverable from origin/main's own history.
